name: Case
description:
``case`` is a PHP keyword, which may be used in three distinct situations: 

+ With ``switch()`` expression
+ With ``match()`` expression
+ With enumeration

``case`` is often complemented with ``default``.
code:
<?php

    enum Suit
    {
        case Hearts;
        case Diamonds;
        case Clubs;
        case Spades;
    }
    
    switch ($i) {
        case 0:
            echo "i equals 0";
            break;
        case 1:
            echo "i equals 1";
            break;
        case 2:
            echo "i equals 2";
            break;
    }

?>
